title: ExPFC Core Input v0.1
description: Input contract from app layer to ExPFC Core. See https://research.pyol.net/concept/bonno-virus-mapping/#17

text.description: Text under analysis (T). The primary content to be judged.

user_profile.description: Individual mental-affliction sensitivity profile (U). Required. When the app cannot acquire it, use Anonymous Baseline U provided by the Core.

context.description: Situational context (C). Optional. The Core operates without it but accuracy improves when supplied.

medium.description: Medium through which the text arrived.

sender_info.description: Information about the sender, if available.

conversation_history.description: Previous messages in the conversation (most recent last).

level.description: Output dimensionality level. 1: 3-dim (three poisons). 2: 9-dim (3×3 minimum model). 3: 108-dim (full ontology).
